scope: One adult representative per current Gallery breed entry, then the existing named cat/age variants. This is a versioned catalogue, not a claim to exhaust every worldwide registry or coat combination.
style: High-fidelity softly painted cozy storybook cat, believable feline anatomy, gently imperfect asymmetrical coat markings, tactile fur or breed-appropriate skin, quiet warm neutral daylight, subdued cream and natural coat colours, no human costume, no exaggerated human expression, no oversaturated colour, no lettering, no watermark.
pose: Grounded seated cat, fixed front three-quarter view, all four paws anatomically accounted for, both eyes visible, tail naturally at one side, neutral closed mouth, stable foot contact. Complete silhouette inside margins. Genuine transparent background.
method: Generate each anatomical component independently from its identity master. Paint hidden attachment regions completely, overlap under fur/skin cover layers, retain generated alpha. Never segment a full-cat image as a substitute for independently generated parts.

parts.request: Seated torso and haunch base ONLY. No head, ears, eyes, chest bib, legs, paws or tail. Complete hidden shoulder and hip connections in breed-appropriate fur or skin.

Chest/neck cover layer ONLY. Breed-appropriate ruff or short coat/skin patch. Full hidden neck and shoulder overlap. No face, legs or paws. Do not give a hairless or short-haired breed a long fluffy bib.

Entire natural tail ONLY, complete hidden root and visible tip. Preserve this breed's actual long, short, kinked or pompom tail; for naturally tailless cats make a tiny rump cover patch instead, do not invent a long tail.
Only viewer-left front foreleg, entire hidden shoulder to toes, seated vertical limb, grounded paw. No other body part. Preserve identity markings.
Only viewer-right front foreleg, entire hidden shoulder to toes, seated vertical limb, grounded paw. No other body part. Preserve identity markings.
Only viewer-left seated hindleg and paw, complete hidden hip connection. Correct bent feline anatomy; no other limb or body part.
Only viewer-right seated hindleg and paw, complete hidden hip connection. Correct bent feline anatomy; no other limb or body part.

Entire head underpainting and short hidden neck ONLY, excluding ears. Preserve exact face shape and coat pattern. Paint continuous matching fur/skin where eyes, nose, mouth and whiskers would attach: no holes, no eyes, no nose, no mouth lines, no whiskers. Separate features are added above.
ONLY viewer-left ear, complete hidden rounded fur/skin base. Preserve actual straight, folded or curled breed-specific ear shape, orientation and marking.
ONLY viewer-right ear, complete hidden rounded fur/skin base. Preserve actual straight, folded or curled breed-specific ear shape, orientation and marking.

ONLY viewer-left almond eye aperture: pale ivory sclera and thin charcoal feline lid rim, no iris or pupil. A narrow soft edge of matching skin/fur overlaps the face. Preserve reference tilt and opening shape.

ONLY viewer-right almond eye aperture: pale ivory sclera and thin charcoal feline lid rim, no iris or pupil. A narrow soft edge of matching skin/fur overlaps the face. Preserve reference tilt and opening shape.

ONLY viewer-left iris disk and natural feline pupil with subtle catchlights; preserve this cat's iris colour. Transparent outside disk, no sclera or eyelids. This is separately clipped by the eye aperture at runtime.
ONLY viewer-right iris disk and natural feline pupil with subtle catchlights; preserve this cat's iris colour including heterochromia. Transparent outside disk, no sclera or eyelids.
ONLY viewer-left upper feline eyelid arch, thin charcoal edge with slender fur/skin overlap above and beyond both corners. No eyeball, iris, sclera, or human eyelashes.
ONLY viewer-right upper feline eyelid arch, thin charcoal edge with slender fur/skin overlap above and beyond both corners. No eyeball, iris, sclera, or human eyelashes.
ONLY viewer-left lower feline eyelid curved strip and narrow breed-appropriate fur/skin overlap below it. No eyeball, sclera or iris.
ONLY viewer-right lower feline eyelid curved strip and narrow breed-appropriate fur/skin overlap below it. No eyeball, sclera or iris.
ONLY small viewer-left brow ridge fur/skin patch, natural feline brow, soft hidden overlap. No human eyebrow, eye, eyelid, or full face.
ONLY small viewer-right brow ridge fur/skin patch, natural feline brow, soft hidden overlap. No human eyebrow, eye, eyelid, or full face.
ONLY viewer-left rounded muzzle/whisker pad, matching fur/skin and tiny follicle dots, full hidden overlap. No long whiskers, nose, mouth lines or eyes.
ONLY viewer-right rounded muzzle/whisker pad, matching fur/skin and tiny follicle dots, full hidden overlap. No long whiskers, nose, mouth lines or eyes.
ONLY small nose leather, nostrils and philtrum root, exact colour and shape of identity master. Transparent outside skin; no muzzle, mouth, eyes or whiskers.
ONLY neutral feline mouth/philtrum curves with a very narrow matching muzzle fur/skin overlap. No human smile, lips, teeth, nose, eyes or whiskers.

ONLY viewer-left cluster of delicate natural whiskers and a tiny soft root pad. Full curved strands with transparent gaps, no cheek or nose. Respect sparse/absent whiskers of the actual cat instead of adding long whiskers to all hairless breeds.
ONLY viewer-right cluster of delicate natural whiskers and a tiny soft root pad. Full curved strands with transparent gaps, no cheek or nose. Respect sparse/absent whiskers of the actual cat.
ONLY viewer-left soft cheek edge cover patch, preserve coat length/skin texture, full overlap at inner edge. No eyes, nose, mouth, or whiskers.
ONLY viewer-right soft cheek edge cover patch, preserve coat length/skin texture, full overlap at inner edge. No eyes, nose, mouth, or whiskers.

review: Generated sources and assembled models remain candidates until reviewed. Do not replace the live hall cat or mark official AssetIndex entries filled automatically. No unmade walk or turn animation may be implied.
git: Keep PNG originals, .stretch candidates, previews, runtime builds, queue state and per-file manifests in ignored art-local. Only code, production specs and small metadata enter Git.
